dimensions.assessment: Affects residents, commuters, drivers, and local government officials in the District of Columbia.
dimensions.evidence: The Council of the District of Columbia may not enact, and the Mayor of the District of Columbia may not enforce... a congestion toll.

dimensions.assessment: Precludes a specific type of local tolling policy within the geographic area of the District of Columbia.
dimensions.evidence: The term congestion toll means any charge for entry into or passing through a congestion tolling zone.

dimensions.assessment: Does not involve federal spending or revenue changes, though it prevents potential local toll revenue generation.
Amends the District of Columbia Home Rule Act to restrict local legislative and executive authority.
dimensions.evidence: Section 602(a) of the District of Columbia Home Rule Act... is amended... by adding at the end the following new paragraph

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent restriction on local governance in the District of Columbia.

missing_information: Whether any specific congestion tolling plans were actively being considered by the District of Columbia prior to the bill
importance_detail.rationale: The bill prohibits the District of Columbia government from enacting or enforcing congestion tolls and amends the D.C. Home Rule Act accordingly.
